about: Changes to the committed public/data/obr_forecast_vintages.json, each with whether a measure so changed reads as its kind. Read by tests/test_forecast_vintages.py (the build's check_kind) and src/utils/forecastVintages/kind.test.js (the page's kindProblem): the two must agree with these and so with each other. Each op names a variable, a measure and (where it needs one) a forecast by its label.
